BUGS: None  
DEAD: `tz_offset_hours`, `lat`, `lon`, and `system` in BirthData have default values but are not used in all cases.  
RISK: No explicit validation for input types (e.g., date, time) in `/daily/{name}` and `/weekly/{name}`.

OK: CLEAN — well-structured, clear error handling, but could benefit from type validation and refactoring.
